text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While walking through the station with Curren Chan,
a woman in a suit approached us.

text_block_list.name: Woman in a Suit
text_block_list.text:
You're!! The famous
Curren from Umastagram, aren't you!?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Wah♪ Do you know about Curren?

text_block_list.name: Woman in a Suit
text_block_list.text:
"Naturally! To be blunt,
would you please consider joining our talent agency!?"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Oh. Thank you for the invitation.
But... I'm afraid I have to pass."

text_block_list.name: Woman in a Suit
text_block_list.text:
W-Why is that?!
Someone as cute as you
belongs in showbiz where you can truly shine!!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: —Have you ever seen Curren run before?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Actually, it seems my fans at the racetrack
are increasing day by day♪
They're all asking, 'Who's that fast, cute girl?!'

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it's strange to think there's a world
where "fast" and "cute" go hand in hand, though.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Still, Curren is confident she can be cuter than anyone else.
Because Curren has—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Because I have the legs you helped train, Big Brother,
and the race plan we came up with together.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Because I've got the legs we trained together, and the race strategy we came up with together.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Actually, Curren isn't just the cutest girl in the world,
she's the cutest Umamusume in the world too♪

text_block_list.name: Woman in a Suit
text_block_list.text:
...! You're right, pardon me.
I think I understand now why you're shining so cutely right now.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Haa, I'm glad they understood!
It's so nice that they were a good person♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"...Ehe, Onii-chan. Curren wants
to become even, even cuter!"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"...Ehe, Onee-chan. Curren wants
to become even, even cuter!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It seems Curren Chan feels that our daily guidance has been paying off...!
